name: MonarchPricingSection
title: PricingSection
wrapsNative: VStack of MonarchPlanCard (HStack at regular width); MonarchSegmentedControl (Picker with .pickerStyle(.segmented)) for the period; MonarchPricingTable in its grid layout for the comparison
summary: The plans of a product on one screen: a header, one billing period picker, a plan card per plan with its features and call to action, a note, and an optional table comparing the plans feature by feature.
whenToUse: On an upgrade or plans screen that shows every plan at once, with prices that may differ by billing period.
whenNotToUse: For a comparison alone, use MonarchPricingTable. For one plan, use MonarchPlanCard. A purchase that must use the store's billing goes through StoreKit (for example SubscriptionStoreView) from the plan's action.
api: init(_ title: String, eyebrow: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, alignment: MonarchMarketingAlignment = .center, plans: [MonarchPricingSectionPlan], periods: [MonarchPricingPeriod] = [], period: Binding<String>? = nil, comparison: [MonarchPricingFeature] = [], comparisonTitle: String? = nil, note: String? = nil, billingPeriodLabel: String? = nil, @ViewBuilder action: @escaping (MonarchPricingSectionPlan) -> Action)

init(_ title: String, eyebrow: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, alignment: MonarchMarketingAlignment = .center, plans: [MonarchPricingSectionPlan], periods: [MonarchPricingPeriod] = [], period: Binding<String>? = nil, comparison: [MonarchPricingFeature] = [], comparisonTitle: String? = nil, note: String? = nil, billingPeriodLabel: String? = nil)  // where Action == EmptyView

MonarchPricingSectionPlan.init(_ id: String, name: String, description: String? = nil, prices: [String: String] = [:], price: String? = nil, priceSuffix: String? = nil, badge: String? = nil, isHighlighted: Bool = false, isCurrent: Bool = false, featuresLabel: String? = nil, features: [MonarchPlanCardFeature] = [])

options.name: eyebrow
options.description: A short label above the title in the accent's strong colour.

options.name: description
options.description: One or two sentences under the title.

options.name: alignment
options.description: Centred or leading header, picker and note.

options.name: plans
options.description: The plans: prices per period id or a fallback price, badge, highlighted and current flags, a features heading and the features.

options.name: periods
options.description: Billing periods. With two or more a segmented picker is shown.

options.name: period
options.description: The selected period id. Without it the section keeps its own, starting with the first.

options.name: comparison
options.description: Feature rows for a comparison table under the cards; empty for none.

options.name: comparisonTitle
options.description: Replaces the built-in comparison title "Compare plans".

options.name: billingPeriodLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in picker name "Billing period".

options.name: action
options.description: The call to action of each plan, normally one full-width MonarchButton.

states.name: cards
states.description: One card per plan, stacked on a phone and side by side at regular width for up to four plans.

states.name: period
states.description: The picker changes every card's price, suffix and note, and the comparison's prices.

states.name: fallback price
states.description: A plan without a price for the period shows its fallback, such as "Contact us", without the suffix and note.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: The plan's card is raised with an accent border and a solid badge.

states.name: comparison
states.description: A heading and a MonarchPricingTable grid of the same plans and period, without its own picker.

appearance: The header follows MonarchMarketingSectionHeader; cards follow MonarchPlanCard; the note uses the muted text colour; the comparison follows MonarchPricingTable. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web PricingSection is a marketing band with a page heading level, tones and spacing presets. On iOS it is a view for an upgrade or plans screen: cards stack on a phone, the period picker is a standard segmented control shared with the comparison, and the band draws no background of its own. Prices are shown exactly as given; where the store's rules apply, the purchase runs through StoreKit from the action. Android does not ship this component.
accessibility: The title and each plan name have the header trait.
The period picker is a standard segmented control named "Billing period".
Each price is read with its suffix; a feature that is not included is read with "Not included:".
The comparison is a container named by its title; each cell is read as the plan, the feature and its value.
edgeCases: Five or more plans stack even at regular width.
At the accessibility text sizes the cards stack and the comparison scrolls sideways.
A period id that no plan prices shows each plan's fallback price.

examples.title: Plans with a period toggle and comparison
examples.code:
MonarchPricingSection(
    "Plans that grow with your team",
    eyebrow: "Pricing",
    description: "Placeholder prices for documentation; pass the prices your billing system publishes.",
    plans: [
        MonarchPricingSectionPlan(
            "starter",
            name: "Starter",
            description: "For individuals getting organised.",
            prices: ["monthly": "₹A", "yearly": "₹B"],
            features: ["Up to 3 projects", "Email support", MonarchPlanCardFeature("Single sign-on", isIncluded: false)]
        ),
        MonarchPricingSectionPlan(
            "team",
            name: "Team",
            description: "For teams that share work every day.",
            prices: ["monthly": "₹C", "yearly": "₹D"],
            badge: "Recommended",
            isHighlighted: true,
            featuresLabel: "Everything in Starter, plus",
            features: ["Unlimited projects", "Single sign-on", "Audit log"]
        ),
        MonarchPricingSectionPlan(
            "enterprise",
            name: "Enterprise",
            description: "For organisations with procurement and security reviews.",
            price: "Contact us",
            featuresLabel: "Everything in Team, plus",
            features: ["Custom contract", "Dedicated onboarding"]
        ),
    ],
    periods: [
        MonarchPricingPeriod("monthly", label: "Monthly", priceSuffix: "/ month"),
        MonarchPricingPeriod("yearly", label: "Yearly", priceSuffix: "/ year", priceNote: "Billed yearly"),
    ],
    period: $period,
    comparison: [
        MonarchPricingFeature("projects", label: "Projects", values: ["starter": "Up to 3", "team": true, "enterprise": true]),
        MonarchPricingFeature("sso", label: "Single sign-on", group: "Security", values: ["starter": false, "team": true, "enterprise": true]),
        MonarchPricingFeature("contract", label: "Custom contract", group: "Security", values: ["enterprise": true]),
    ],
    note: "Prices shown before taxes."
) { plan in
    switch plan.id {
    case "starter":
        MonarchButton("Choose Starter", variant: .secondary, fullWidth: true) {}
    case "team":
        MonarchButton("Choose Team", variant: .primary, fullWidth: true) {}
    default:
        MonarchButton("Talk to sales", variant: .secondary, fullWidth: true) {}
    }
}
